name: Entrepreneurship
description:
The lecture is part of the module Entrepreneurial, Strategic, and International Management. Currently, you can only sign up for the entire module on TUMonline. Even if you only want to take part in the Entrepreneurship lecture, please sign up for the entire module. You are still able to only work on the ECTS for Entrepreneurship.

The lecture "Entrepreneurship" provides students with knowledge of important concepts and models of entrepreneurship. Students will acquire in-depth knowledge on:
- Entrepreneurial individuals, including their personalities, affect, creativity, decision-making processes, and team collaboration
- Entrepreneurial opportunities, including how they are identified, developed, and structured
- Entrepreneurial firms, including establishment, growth strategies, strategic alliances, and resource management
- The entrepreneurial context and types, including social and sustainable ventures
